payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE: shipped RedisClusterBus + createRedisClusterBus (commit d670dd5). FrickClusterBus over Redis pub/sub, msgpack-encoded, dedicated pub+sub connections, originNodeId loop guard + setSubscribedTenants parity with MemoryClusterBus, ioredis as a lazily-imported optional dep behind the small RedisBusClient surface. Validated against real Redis (tests/redis-cluster-bus.test.ts, gated on FRICK_REDIS_URL; fake-client unit coverage always runs). Server suite 784 green. Inject via createFrickServer({clusterBus}).
